extracted_concepts.name: Counting to 100
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sequentially counting numbers up to one hundred by ones and tens.

extracted_concepts.name: Cardinality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understanding the fundamental relationship between abstract numbers and concrete quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Addition

extracted_concepts.name: Subtraction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The mathematical operation of taking apart and taking from quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Place Value
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Understanding the positional value of digits in tens and ones columns.

extracted_concepts.name: Measurement Length
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Determining the extent of an object using standard length units.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Organizing, visually representing, and drawing conclusions from collected information.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Shapes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Distinct two-dimensional and three-dimensional figures defined by specific attributes.

extracted_concepts.name: Equal Groups
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Collections of objects arranged in identical sets, serving as a foundation for multiplication.

extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Counting forward by fixed numerical intervals such as 5s, 10s, or 100s.

extracted_concepts.name: Defining Attributes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Essential geometric properties that classify a shape and distinguish it from others.

extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic within 20
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Executing addition and subtraction operations where operands and results remain at or below twenty.

extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic within 1000
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Counting and performing foundational operations within the thousands numerical range.

extracted_concepts.name: Two-Dimensional Shapes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Flat geometric figures bounded by straight or curved lines.

extracted_concepts.name: Three-Dimensional Shapes
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Solid geometric figures possessing volume, faces, edges, and vertices.

extracted_concepts.name: Time Halves
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Clock configurations indicating thirty minutes past a given hour.
